---
title: "6.2 The set page gotcha"
format: typst
---

Some text before the set rules, written in Markdown.

```{=typst}
#set page(margin: 1in, fill: rgb("#fdfbf5"))

This text comes after the set rules.
```

<!--
EXPECTED RESULT (two pages)
Page 1: the title and the Markdown sentence, white, default look.
Page 2: "This text comes after the set rules." on a cream page.
WHY: Quarto writes the title first. Typst cannot change page settings
halfway down a page, so it starts a new page.
NEXT: open 6-3-using-styles.qmd for the fix.
-->
